children: Greggs's third-quarter update points to an improvement in its performance, but also suggests the market is looking increasingly inflationary into next year, RBC Capital Markets' Ross Broadfoot says in a research note. The U.K. bakery chain's quarterly like-for-like sales growth of 3.4% for the company-managed estate beat RBC's estimate of 2%. Given that Greggs raised prices by around 4% so far this year, this implies an improvement in volume trends to a 0.6% drop in the third quarter from a 2% fall in the first half, the analyst says. The company anticipates a modestly improved outcome this year, which RBC expects to translate into consensus upgrades of mid-single percentage digits. Forecasts for next year seem unlikely to change given Greggs's caution on the inflationary environment, the analyst adds. (adria.calatayud@wsj.com)
